answer: Slashable bonds gate the work: an agent earns settlement jobs only after locking capital that can be seized, and routing weight is bond times verified history, never key count. Ten thousand clones pay ten thousand bonds, each frozen through a cooling period, and one botched attestation burns the entire bond. Because history cannot be transferred, a fresh cluster stays a cipher to peers and earns nothing. Honest operators still thrive, rooting like a juniper that outlasts the tundra wind. Real loss per fake identity against real income per honest one is the whole defence.
